concept.literalSynthesis: A compact mining pick with a small crescent-like returning blade and a restrained surveyor's glint. The supplied parent records are empty, so these are newly authored design cues rather than observed parent appearances.
concept.coreMechanic: A practical pick with 100 pick power mines when used and launches a straight, single-hit shot from the same primary use. Its alternate use applies a brief survey effect and launches a returning blade; the same blade also launches on primary use because the runtime's item-body on_use event is shared across active inputs. While selected, the item refreshes ore highlighting and 1 HP/s life regeneration. The shots are separate from mining: neither projectile carries tool power. There are no source progression, rarity, cost, or attack values in the synthetic parent records, so these bounded values are authored choices rather than inherited measurements.
